title: Inherited triangulation on the quasi-coherent derived category of an algebraic space
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme and $X$ an algebraic space over $S$. Use the small ringed model and the full subcategory $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)$ of the unbounded derived category supplied by [def-sfb-space-derived-module-calculus], with arbitrary localization morphism universe. Equip this existing full subcategory with the induced triangulation: shifts are the ambient shifts, and a triangle is distinguished exactly when its image under the full inclusion is distinguished in $D(\mathcal O_X)$. The quasi-coherent-cohomology predicate contains zero and is stable under integer shifts and distinguished triangles, so Mathlib's induced full-subcategory triangulation applies.
